stories.title: Surendra Koli, accused in Nithari killings, found dead in his Haridwar tea shop

en.title: Surendra Koli, accused in Nithari killings, found dead in his Haridwar tea shop

en.title: Football vs Envelope: Mamata Banerjee's Party, Rebels Get New Name, Symbol

The rebel faction led by Arup Roy received the envelope symbol and 'Democratic Trinamool Congress' name, while Mamata Banerjee's group got the football player symbol and 'Mamata All India Trinamool Congress' name.
